draft_evidence.quote:
The light came onto the floor first, as it had the morning before, and he watched it come from the rut.

Positions, catalogued at first grey, because he had been awake the whole of the dark and a count was what he had. Lira on her back on the road where Oryn had left her, the left arm bound across her chest from the shoulder, the right hand flat on the rut beside her, the taped foot turned out; she had not moved in the night. Oryn a stride beyond her, on her side now, the leather roll under her head and her hands tucked into the carter's coat. Karis against the middle box with the notebook shut on her knees, asleep sitting, charcoal still on her fingers and the dark going up both sides of her throat into the collar. Brom on the box with the crossbow across his thighs and the right hand wrapped in Oryn's linen, awake, looking not at the ring but at the scrub. Seln at the stone, standing, with his back to the camp, where he had stood since full dark.

The mule, hipshot, at the road's edge. The lantern out.

One dead hound in the rut against the stone, its forefeet across the line and the rest of it inside, the bolt standing out of its chest. The other was on the floor's west lip, two hundred meters back, and nobody was going to go and get that one.

comparison_evidence.quote: Lira's arm state carried (slung, not used); Karis voiceless (writing to speak); the cache present and unopened.

findings.consequence: A full-draft exact search for 'cache' returns zero, and the opening position/possession catalogue accounts for Seln, the middle box, mule, roll, crossbow, notebook, and lantern without placing the locked intelligence cache anywhere. Absence does not prove it was lost, but it fails the packet's explicit requirement to make the carried, unopened object present, leaving the later trap's load-bearing possession without its assigned continuity beat.
findings.repair_target: Put the locked cache physically on the page as present and unopened without opening it, describing its contents, advancing its thread, or adding new action.

draft_evidence.quote:
Seln came along the line from the north.

He had been gone since first light — north along the line's outside, where seven hounds had run in the dark — and he came back along it now with his knife put away and his eyes on the ground until the ground brought him to the stake. He stopped. He looked at Oryn against it, and at the flat top of it standing a finger over her hair, and at the number punched under the registry's mark, thirty-one.

Cael had never once learned Seln's face, and did not learn it now; but he saw something happen to it. It was not a change. It was the absence of one — the face going still in a way it had not been still a stride before, the stillness of a man at a shelf with his hand halfway to a book he had not remembered owning.

"Seven went north," Seln said, to the stake. "Along the line. They didn't cross it. There's a place a mile up where they stopped and stood a while, all together, and went on. They've not come back." Then, with no change at all in the voice: "Karis's map. The carter's. Not the sheet."

comparison_evidence.quote: No travel beyond the camp; no fight; no fragment use (idle texture only).

findings.consequence: Seln leaves the camp after first light, tracks the hounds a mile north, and returns with a new movement report. That is travel beyond the camp under the plain scope of the categorical prohibition, and it adds an unassigned off-camp scouting event to a chapter whose specified shape is the unit lying still at the stone.
findings.repair_target: Keep Seln and all chapter action within the camp while preserving the assigned stake-triggered memory, map demonstration, and unopened-cache state; do not add a replacement excursion or new hound finding.

draft_evidence.quote: *Seln remembered something today, against the stake, and I'm entering it once, as he said it, without a verb. The maps they carry past the Line have holes in them. Blanks, at the spacing of the carter's circles. He drew one from memory over the Fallow Ring and it lay on the carter's to a finger's width. Surveyed, five years ago by the stake, maybe six; the circles paced, the stakes stamped, the maps drawn with holes where the circles are. Not ignorance; ignorance doesn't stamp iron. They know what quiet ground does, and it's filed where we can't reach. Karis wrote WHERE and he said no; he carried the maps and never saw the file. Entered.*

comparison_evidence.quote: Seln's memory beat: the Compact maps' blanks; the circle drawn from memory over the Fallow Ring that matches; his lines verbatim ('They surveyed it... Ignorance doesn't stamp iron.'); the finding stated once, flat (the Compact knows what quiet ground does and has filed it somewhere they can't reach); nothing pursued.

findings.consequence: After Seln already states the finding flatly at lines 153-161, the second-night log repeats the map blanks, matching circle, survey age, paced circles, stamped stakes, ignorance line, Compact knowledge, inaccessible file, Karis's question, and Seln's limit. The chapter therefore lands the deliberately single plant twice and explains it again after the first scene has already made it clear, weakening the packet's controlled one-statement advance.
findings.repair_target: Keep the complete in-scene Seln finding and the required two-night log track, but prevent the second log from restating the Compact finding or pursuing its supporting explanation.

concerns: Authority tension, not a manuscript defect: the packet lists Cael's calf among Oryn's morning mendings, but Chapters 6-7 establish that she cannot mend what she cannot read, and Chapter 13 depends on her never having touched his architecture successfully. The draft correctly follows the higher-authority continuity rule and makes the three-mending arithmetic Lira's arm, Karis's throat, and Brom's hand. The packet should eventually be normalized so a later seat does not try to 'repair' the canon-consistent choice.

Taste only: the second-night log repeats much of the day's injury and institutional accounting after both have been rendered clearly in scene. Finding ed-b7-ch12-003 covers the contractually prohibited Compact-finding echo; beyond that verified issue, a later compression pass could test whether the remaining recap earns its audio length at the top of the target band.

Taste only: the final paragraph accumulates Oryn's third and fourth tests, her route history, eight crossings, Cael's filing restraint, the returning light, her walk back, and her position beside Lira in one long cadence. The image is strong and comprehensible, but its audio performance will need the internal turns voiced distinctly so the final act of lying beside Lira does not blur the assigned line-test image.
strengths: Yes: the worldbuilding is done through mechanism and use. Tide healing is a sequence of hands, readings, elapsed light, visible reserve loss, route arithmetic, food, mule care, and untreated patients eleven days north. Compact reach is a punched stake, remembered map blanks, registry diction, broker pricing, Pike's ledger columns, and a ferry copy. The institutions and magic act on bodies, objects, access, and time.

There is no fight, exactly as prohibited, so a combat win sentence of the form 'X removed Y's ability to Z' is not applicable. The noncombat set pieces are nevertheless memorable and terrain-load-bearing: the survey stake serves as Oryn's physical backrest and the trigger for Seln's professional memory; the carter-map overlap makes the institutional discovery visible; the stone and sharp line make Oryn's four-trial dawn experiment reproducible. The clean mechanism sentence is: the line removes Oryn's ability to read or mend by stopping the current at one stride, and she verifies that removal four times.

The calf sequence protects reader trust under an internally conflicting work order. Oryn examines the actual wound, performs the fourth failed reading, states the invariant, and binds it instead of silently acquiring an exception. The result preserves both Tide's limitation and Chapter 13's premise while keeping Cael's injury active.

Oryn's reserve cost is unusually concrete. Karis's swallow changes, Brom keeps four dark finger lines, Oryn's face greys and sweats, she puts her head between her knees, the arm counts as one and the size of two, and the far end of her route lengthens where she cannot see it. Professional competence and independent want occupy the same arithmetic.

Seln's map demonstration is excellent object-based exposition. Covering the carter's bend with his palm, drawing the dashed road and circle from memory, then revealing a finger-width match turns suppressed institutional knowledge into a physical test rather than a speech. His refusal to invent the missing file preserves his professional voice and the reveal boundary.

The contract re-read renders institutional antagonism as a machine: insider vocabulary identifies authorship; false recovery pricing selects a crew; Pike records posting, taking, witnessing, and completion; the broker receives the copy; the ferry carries the answer west. The Compact never needs a present villain to exert pressure.

Found-family movement remains behavioral. Brom breaks Lira's bread without asking; Cael tapes her ankle; nobody forces the fragment conversation; Oryn objects that she is a stop; Cael declines to file her private dawn test. Affection and trust are carried through work, restraint, and ownership rather than declared feeling.

The closing image pays the packet cleanly. Oryn runs the count in her own raised hands, crosses in and out four times, turns three anecdotes into a finding, and Cael keeps the book shut because the evidence is hers. Chapter 11's dialogue close and Chapter 12's observed image are structurally distinct.

Production and continuity are otherwise disciplined: 5,247 words is within tolerance; metadata and summary greps are clean; every capped tic remains within limit; attribution survives audio; no modern register or prohibited pitch phrase appears; all names pass the registry ear check; nine fragments plus the anomaly remain exact; and every injury is side-specific and carried forward.
